newsitem.title: USA: Applebee's to acquire St. Louis franchisee.
newsitem.headline: Applebee's to acquire St. Louis franchisee.

text.p: Applebee's International Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire 11 Applebee's restaurants in the St. Louis, Mo. market area from its franchisee, Apple Partners L.P., for about $36.1 million.

Applebee's will also acquire several restaurants under development, including two which are expected to open in the first half of 1997. After closing, Applebee's will continue the further development of the St. Louis market.
Terms of the agreement call for Applebee's to reimburse Apple Partners for costs incurred for the restaurants under development. The $36.1 million purchase price may be adjusted.

In addition, Applebee's said it will assume certain operating and capitalized lease obligations relating to the acquired restaurants. The purchase price will be paid in a combination of cash and $2.5 million of promissory notes, and the transaction will be accounted for as a purchase.
Final closing requires obtaining operating licenses and third party consents and is expected to occur early in the second quarter of 1997, the company said in a statement.
Total sales for the 11 St. Louis area Applebee's restaurants (including two restaurants which opened in April of 1996) were $27.9 million for the year ended Dec. 29, 1996.
The average annual restaurant sales of these units were about $2.7 million in 1996.

Apple Partners L.P. is also the Applebee's franchisee for the Portland, Ore. market and has signed an agreement to sell its five Portland Applebee's restaurants and restaurants under development to another existing Applebee's franchisee.

"This transaction is an important acquisition for our company and is consistent with our strategy of acquiring franchise operations located in selected markets with high population density where market presence has been firmly established and there remains the potential for significant future expansion," said Abe Gustin Jr, Applebee's International chairman, in a statement.

Applebee's International develops, franchises and operates casual dining restaurants in 45 states and four international countries, under the trademarks of Applebee's Neighborhood Grill and Bar and Rio Bravo Cantina.
